title: Mission control split between NASA and the Air Force

tellings.quote: at the consoles. And you look to the left, it's exactly the same, but it's all Air Force people.

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, who says he draws UFOs to him and is studied by NASA, says mission control at Cape Canaveral is split in two: NASA people sit at one bank of consoles, and "you look to the left, it's exactly the same, but it's all Air Force people." Bledsoe tells it as something he saw himself, and he mentions a man named Timothy Taylor in telling it. The point is that the military runs a twin operation right next to the civilian space programme.
